jobs.title: Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking)
jobs.description:
Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking)

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Contract type: Full-time

Salary: Starting from €50,000 OTE per annum gross (60% base / 40% bonus), subject to location, skills and experience


Not Your Typical Workplace:

Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.

More Than a Role

The Swiss market is full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders. A Zurich scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. A Basel founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. As our Account Executive Switzerland, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to Swiss companies.

This role is built for an AE who already knows how to close and is ready to take full ownership of their deals. You win by advising with substance, not by pushing a product. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:

  • Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle for your Swiss accounts, from first conversation to onboarded talent.
  • Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.
  • Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.
  • Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.
  • Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.


What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Your Background: At least 1 year of closing experience as an AE in B2B SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating your quota. You're self-driven and ready to walk us through your numbers.
  • Discovery & Qualification: You run sharp discovery and qualify with a methodology such as MEDDICC, so you know early which deals are real.
  • Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.
  • AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.
  • Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.
  • Swiss German Native: Native Swiss German and business-fluent English. You understand what makes Swiss buyers tick. / Or you Fluent in Both German and French

Bonus Points If You Bring:

  • existing network among HR leaders or founders in Switzerland
  • Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions
  • French language skills, to open doors in Romandy too
  • Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role


Not Your Typical Team:

We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.


The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you'll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.


* Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at ----- We're here to support you every step of the way!

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager SaaS/AI Startup f/m/d
jobs.description:
About PULT

PULT is the Workplace Presence & Visitor Platform for fast growing companies. We help IT, Workplace and People teams understand who is actually in the office, run compliant visitor management, and make better decisions about their space.

We are a Hamburg-based B2B SaaS company, backed by strong investors, with customers like VEVO, Wellhub and SG Fleet. We are post-seed, growing fast, and preparing the next stage of the company. Marketing is one of the biggest levers we have, and it still has a lot of untouched potential. That is where you come in.

Your first months at Pult

We are hiring a senior marketing / growth manager: one person who owns the full funnel, end to end, and scales what works. A bold, AI-native generalist who wants the whole board.

PULT is growing fast and opening international markets. You will turn it into a repeatable, measurable engine, and you will have the mandate, the budget and the backing to do it.

If you have been waiting for the role where you finally get to run marketing rather than a slice of it, this is it.

Your mission:

Demand generation

  • Plan and run paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google and the channels you discover next, with full ownership of budget and ROI

  • Own the website and conversion funnel together with our web agency: messaging, landing pages, experiments

  • Build the organic engine: SEO, AI search visibility, content that IT and People leaders actually want to read

  • Run our webinar programme and turn it into a reliable pipeline source

Brand and storytelling

  • Sharpen PULT's positioning and make sure every touchpoint tells the same bold story

  • Produce standout content: campaigns, videos, case studies, product launches, founder and customer stories

  • Set a high bar for design and copy, and hold the team and agencies to it

Offline and events

  • Take PULT to the events that matter in DACH and the UK, from trade fairs to our own customer dinners and roundtables

  • Run account-based campaigns into our target accounts, online and offline, together with Sales

Engine and scale

  • Own the marketing stack (HubSpot, analytics, AI tooling) and the data behind it: attribution, CAC, MQL growth, pipeline contribution

  • Use AI as a force multiplier for research, content, creative and ops, and build the agents and workflows that let a small team move like a big one

  • Define the marketing roadmap, report on results to the leadership team, and hire the first marketing team members as we scale

What the role requires

  • A generalist with range. 3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally in a scale-up, with hands-on experience across paid, online and offline channels. You have run campaigns, written the copy, briefed the designer and read the dashboard yourself.

  • AI-native. You already work with AI every day: for research, content, creative, analysis and automation. You see where the tools are heading and you build with them, not around them.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a brief. You get excited by ambitious goals, find the path, and ship.

  • A storyteller with taste. Exceptional writing in English (German is a strong plus) and a sharp eye for design. You know the difference between content that fills a calendar and content that moves people.

  • Bold. You would rather launch something people talk about than something safe that nobody notices. You bring ideas we have not thought of.

  • ROI first. You think in pipeline, not impressions. You are comfortable with budgets, CAC, conversion rates and the conversation with Sales about lead quality.

  • International. You have experience in DACH and / or UKI market. You excited about expanding into new markets.

  • A builder. You want to be the leading marketing hire, expand on the foundations, and grow into leading a team.

Benefits

This is a remote-first position. You will have access to career training to support your professional development. A company laptop is provided for your daily work. Stay active with a sport membership. Enjoy flexible working hours. Company stock options give you a stake in the company's growth. Paid co-working options are also available.

Compensation

EUR 50,000–65,000 per year

Join PULT

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to shape the future of workplaces across the world, we encourage you to apply. You will be joining an early-stage startup where your contributions directly impact growth and product adoption.

jobs.title: Senior SAP Logistics Consultant - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
ÜBER UNS:

Wir sind die 24 Log GmbH, ein innovatives und wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der SAP Logistik. Unsere Mission ist es, die komplexen Herausforderungen der modernen Logistik mit intelligenten, zielstrebigen und benutzerfreundlichen Lösungen zu meistern. Von der Konzeption über die Realisierung und Implementierung bis hin zum flächendeckenden, internationalen Rollout und Betrieb begleiten wir Ihre Projekte gewissenhaft und zielorientiert.

Mit unseren SAP-basierten IT-Logistiklösungen und Systemintegrationen sichern wir den reibungslosen Ablauf Ihrer logistischen Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, dass Ihre Projekte erfolgreich und termingerecht abgeschlossen werden.

WIR BIETEN:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Firmenwagen: Für die Ausübung deiner Tätigkeiten stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung, damit du flexibel und komfortabel unterwegs bist - auch privat. Du hast freie Fahrzeugauswahl!

  • BIKELEASING: Du leistest dir dein Wunschfahrrad günstig über unser "Jobrad"-Programm. Umweltfreundlich und fit unterwegs – wir unterstützen dich dabei!

  • Vielfältige Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VWL) und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (BAV). Wir bieten dir zudem flexible Arbeitszeiten und freie Zeitgestaltung.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Arbeit lebt von einem positiven und kundenorientierten Umfeld. Nur wer selbst positiv eingestellt ist, kann auch andere begeistern.

  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeitenden erhalten ein marktgerechtes Gehalt und können von zahlreichen weiteren Leistungen profitieren. Du hast zudem die Möglichkeit, über unser partizipatives Modell fortlaufend von den Erfolgen in der Umsetzung persönlich zu profitieren.

  • Individuelle Entfaltungsmöglichkeiten: Spannende Projekte mit viel Potenzial für die eigene Entwicklung und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, das individuell eingesetzt werden darf.


DEINE AUFGABENBEREICHE:

  • Leitung von Projekten im Rahmen der S/4HANA-Transformation.

  • Entwicklung und Anpassung von komplexen SAP-Logistikmodulen nach spezifischen Kundenanforderungen.

  • Führung und Coaching von Junior Consultants und Teammitgliedern zur erfolgreichen Durchführung der Kundenprojekte.

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung und Einführung von innovativen SAP-Technologien wie FIORI/UI5 und ABAP-Entwicklung.

  • Beratung und Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Logistikprozesse und der Implementierung neuer SAP-Lösungen.



DEIN PROFIL:

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Informatiker oder vergleichbares Studium.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im SAP-Logistik-Umfeld.

  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung und/oder mit FIORI/UI5.

  • Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten und eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit.

  • Führungsqualitäten und die Fähigkeit, Projekte und Teams erfolgreich zu managen.

  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Account Executive Enterprise France
jobs.description:
🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.

We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.


As our Account Executive ENT you’ll drive new enterprise business, expand existing relationships, and secure long-term partnerships across engineering, DevOps, and security teams.

You’ll prospect the right companies, run the deal end-to-end, and expand the relationship once they’re customers. You’ll sell directly to engineering, DevOps, and security teams and make sure Aikido becomes their default security platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the full cycle for a defined list of enterprise targets from first touch to close.

  • Build and deepen relationships with senior engineering, platform, and security leaders.
